hook: Burger King is selling company-operated restaurants to local franchisees to rescue its U.S. turnaround.

sections.voiceover: Burger King is selling company-operated restaurants to local franchisees to rescue its U.S. turnaround.
Restaurant Brands International bought Carrols Restaurant Group for $1 billion dollars to kick off the pivot. Where are 200 locations heading by year end?
Local operators are taking over those exact restaurants right now.

Restaurant Brands International plans to hold only 300 restaurants directly in the long term. Local buyers acquired the rest to accelerate store growth. 200 locations are changing hands by the end of 2026.
300 restaurants remain under direct corporate control.
